The smell of cooking meat, fruits and something distinctly human wafts in the air as the large demon lady takes a deep breath. She looks around, her red eyes scanning her surroundings sharply. Then, her gaze lands on a stall selling exotic fruits and vegetables. With a newfound sense of curiosity, she approaches the stall.*

She quickly puts them away in her wicker basket and places four gold coins onto the stall.* "Keep the change, okay?" *She shoots the vendor another friendly smile before continuing down into the heart of the market.*
